We value your privacy

We use cookies to enhance your browsing experience, serve personalized ads or content, and analyze our traffic. By clicking "Accept All", you consent to our use of cookies.

Customize Consent Preferences

We use cookies to help you navigate efficiently and perform certain functions. You will find detailed information about all cookies under each consent category below.

The cookies that are categorized as "Necessary" are stored on your browser as they are essential for enabling the basic functionalities of the site.... 

Always Active

Necessary cookies are required to enable the basic features of this site, such as providing secure log-in or adjusting your consent preferences. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable data.

Functional cookies help perform certain functionalities like sharing the content of the website on social media platforms, collecting feedback, and other third-party features.

Analytical cookies are used to understand how visitors interact with the website. These cookies help provide information on metrics such as the number of visitors, bounce rate, traffic source, etc.

Performance cookies are used to understand and analyse the key performance indexes of the website which helps in delivering a better user experience for the visitors.

Advertisement cookies are used to provide visitors with customised advertisements based on the pages you visited previously and to analyse the effectiveness of the ad campaigns.

Other uncategorised cookies are those that are being analysed and have not been classified into a category as yet.

2026 NKU Cybersecurity Symposium – Friday, October 16

Ticket sales open August 3!

Cyber19 is the region's one-of-a-kind premier cybersecurity symposium.

As the world becomes increasingly reliant on technology, it's more important than ever to stay up-to-date on the latest developments in cybersecurity. That's why we've assembled a dynamic lineup of industry experts, thought leaders, and innovative practitioners to share their knowledge, insights, and best practices.

What to Expect:

  • Industry-Leading Speakers
    • Hear from experts on AI security, ransomware defense, phishing prevention, and emerging threats.
  • Interactive Workshop
    • Gain hands-on experience with the latest cybersecurity tools and techniques.
  • Panel Discussions
    • Engage with thought-provoking conversations between industry leaders.
  • Networking Opportunities
    • Connect with fellow professionals during breaks, lunch, and our closing cocktail reception.
  • Virtual Sponsor Showcase
    • Explore innovative solutions from leading cybersecurity vendors.

Sponsorship Opportunities

Sponsorship levels range from $500 to $10,000, with benefits including prominent
branding, exhibitor booths, complimentary passes, and more. Learn more about sponsorship levels and last year’s attendee data.

Interested? Email Abby Ober: obera1@nku.edu
